sources.title: How much you need for a down payment
sources.note: 5% up to $500,000; 5% of the first $500,000 plus 10% of the remainder up to $1.5 million; 20% at $1.5 million or more.

sources.title: CMHC Mortgage Loan Insurance Explained
sources.note: Mortgage insurance is generally required below 20% down for an eligible home priced below $1.5 million. The standard homeowner schedule is recorded separately in this snapshot.
